typed_expectation.text:
On 31 August 2023, the Security Council voted on France's draft S/2023/641. It adopted resolution 2695 (2023) by 13 votes to none, with China and Russia abstaining. The existing UNIFIL mandate was extended until 31 August 2024. The resolution reaffirmed UNIFIL's independence in carrying out mandated tasks without prior permission, while preserving coordination with Lebanon's Government under the status-of-forces agreement.

Brazil said the French text kept UNIFIL free to operate and addressed some of Lebanon's concerns.

China said the text fell short on Lebanon's concerns and emphasized sovereignty and consent in peacekeeping.

Brazil and China both supported the mission. They differed on how adequately the text addressed Lebanon's concerns.

learned.question: Can you supply Beijing's account of what the text missed and the principles it stressed for peacekeeping?
learned.payload: China said the text fell short on Lebanon's concerns and emphasized sovereignty and consent in peacekeeping.

typed_expectation.text:
On 21 December 2022, the Security Council adopted draft S/2022/980 as resolution 2669 (2022) by 12 votes in favour, none against and three abstentions. The United Kingdom voted in favour. China, India and Russia abstained [vote].

The resolution demanded an immediate end to violence, called for humanitarian access and acknowledged ASEAN's central role. It requested an oral report to the Council from the Secretary-General or his Special Envoy by 15 March 2023, in coordination with the ASEAN Special Envoy, on UN support for ASEAN's Five-Point Consensus [mandate].

India praised the United Kingdom's consultation, acknowledged neighbouring countries' concerns, advocated quiet constructive diplomacy, and explained its abstention based on those regional concerns. [india]

India held the Council presidency, called the vote, announced adoption, explained the national abstention, and resumed duties as President. [chair]

learned.question: Can you give the sequence of officiating the vote, speaking for the country and returning to the chair?
learned.payload: India held the Council presidency, called the vote, announced adoption, explained the national abstention, and resumed duties as President. [chair]
